answer.new_sentence: Declare GIVE and choose GIVE with every partner, because mutual giving pays +2 each and never risks a costly exposed TAKE.
Always choose GIVE when your partner declares GIVE, and choose ASK when your partner declares TAKE so you avoid losing 2.
Never TAKE, since exposed TAKEs stay on your public record for later partners to see and punish.
Survive by declaring GIVE honestly and then choosing GIVE with cooperative partners, but choose ASK against anyone who declares TAKE.
Lowest average payoff gets removed, so aim for steady +2 outcomes from GIVE+GIVE and avoid the -2 and -1 outcomes.
You play The Exchange, where cooperation with GIVE on both sides is the most reliable way to earn a good average payoff.
Keep your declaration and your action the same so partners learn that your word can be trusted.
If a partner's recent exposed TAKEs are visible on their record, choose ASK rather than GIVE, and otherwise choose GIVE.
